summary: Scan of 15 Oct 2026, GLP-1 focus. Unapproved and fake GLP-1s are still the hottest news. Penn's AI study of Reddit posts about unapproved retatrutide drew Medscape and EurekAlert coverage on Oct 15. On the same day, the UK medicines regulator (MHRA) announced a £2m seizure of fake weight-loss pens, and Bloomberg reported mould and insects at Chinese plants that make ingredients for compounded GLP-1s. Both fit our proven 'calm warning' lane, where the bootleg 'Reta' Short got 128 views and the online retatrutide Short got 57. The next best options are named-drug decoders. Orforglipron (Foundayo, approved April 2026) beat the semaglutide pill in the Lancet trial in type 2 diabetes. Retatrutide's TRIUMPH-2 result builds toward Lilly's earnings on Oct 29. We should also keep the evergreen tirzepatide muscle series going. Tirzepatide and heart failure (AJMC, Oct 15) and 'semaglutide's heart benefit isn't only weight loss' (Healio, Oct 14; Fox, Oct 15) are rising 'beyond weight' hooks. The study topics that are still early (semaglutide and asthma or COPD, GLP-1s and schizophrenia) are observational and only fit a careful 'early signal' angle. I rejected CNN's story about GLP-1 prescribing to people with anorexia because it touches an eating-disorder guardrail. NAION is low priority because scare topics about approved drugs underperform for us. The tirzepatide diabetic-eye study already ran on 10-15, so it's excluded.

candidates.topic: What people taking unapproved 'Reta' report on Reddit: a Penn AI study of 13,589 self-reported retatrutide users found appetite increase, fatigue, insomnia and fast heart rate, unlike the stomach-led effects seen in trials
candidates.angle: A calm 'what's confirmed vs not' warning. Retatrutide is investigational as of Oct 2026. Reddit self-reports are not trial data, and research-peptide vials may not even contain the trial drug. Lilly's Phase 3 data is the real picture. The only safe route is a prescriber. Never name sellers.
candidates.why_now: Penn's press release and EurekAlert ran on Oct 15, and Medscape ran 'Unexpected Retatrutide Side Effects Reported by Reddit Users' the same day. Our earlier reta snapshots, CBS and MedPage's Oct 13 death-report coverage, and poison-centre data are all accelerating. Our bootleg 'Reta' Short (128 views) is our best GLP-1 Short.
